title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.7.0
subtitle: Quick role assignment and one release repository.

highlights.title: Quick Assign
highlights.description: Assign Cloth, Cable, Rigid Body, Soft Body or Collider from the floating Add bubble. The selected role is highlighted in blue with a labeled radial sector.

highlights.title: Clear status messages
highlights.description: Errors and other messages appear beside the Bake button, outside the floating toolbar pill.

highlights.title: Superhive status
highlights.description: Preferences now show Superhive connected and Purchase validated using Blender repository data. Customer updates are handled by Superhive through Blender.
